customer care executive.title: Customer Care Executive
customer care executive.reason: Involves direct customer interaction and communication skills which are transferable to a hotel front desk.

customer support executive.title: Customer Support Executive
customer support executive.reason: Requires handling customer inquiries and professional communication, similar to hotel reception duties.

data entry operator.title: Data Entry Operator
data entry operator.reason: Focuses primarily on typing and database management rather than the interpersonal and guest-facing skills required for a receptionist.

front desk executive.title: Front Desk Executive
front desk executive.reason: This is essentially the same role as a hotel receptionist, involving direct guest management.

front office assistant.title: Front Office Assistant
front office assistant.reason: This role is functionally identical to a receptionist in a hotel setting.

guest relations executive.title: Guest Relations Executive
guest relations executive.reason: This role involves managing guest experiences and front-of-house operations, which is the core of a receptionist's job.

receptionist.title: Receptionist
receptionist.reason: This is the exact title of the job being filled.

telecaller.title: Telecaller
telecaller.reason: Primarily focused on outbound calling rather than the face-to-face guest management required for a hotel front desk.
